title: Features
description: What ATHA does, and what it deliberately does not do.

items.title: Guided breathing sessions
items.summary: 10 built-in patterns guided by an ambient visual, haptic taps and optional soft phase tones. Eyes-closed mode dims the screen.

items.title: Custom breathing patterns
items.summary: Set inhale, hold, exhale and hold-out yourself; any hold can be zero. Sessions run from 1 to 60 minutes.

items.title: Ambient breathing visuals
items.summary: Aura, Orb, Box, Glow, Ripple, Wave, Liquid, Aurora, Flower and Particles, all moving with the same breath.

items.title: Routines and reminders
items.summary: Schedule a practice and let a local reminder bring you back to it.

items.title: The Garden
items.summary: Your cumulative practice grows a scene from seed to forest. A metaphor, not a claim.

items.title: Insights and records
items.summary: Mindful minutes, streaks, completion rate, calendar history and your own effective practices.

items.title: Apple Health
items.summary: Optional and write-only: Mindful Minutes and State of Mind. ATHA reads nothing, and core breathing never needs Health.

items.title: Widgets, Watch and Shortcuts
items.summary: Apple Watch haptics, Home and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri: "Breathe now with ATHA".

items.title: Themes and appearance
items.summary: Eight themes (ATHA, Ocean, Sunset, Forest, Lavender, Midnight, Aurora, Sand) with System, Light or Dark appearance.

items.title: On-device by design
items.summary: No account, no server, no analytics: the app makes no network requests. Apple's privacy label: Data Not Collected.

items.title: Free, with no ads
items.summary: The whole app, at no cost. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no advertising, no account.
